content: Each record has a distinct original situation, authored location, prerequisites, staged objectives, NPC behaviour, audiovisual assets and failure/retry conditions.
Completion follows observed gameplay events and required participant state, never entering a marker or pressing a generic complete button.
A clean save reaches the activity; success and every documented failure case are exercised; resulting state survives save/load.
vehicle: Deliver an original identifiable model with working seats, doors, wheels/rotors or hull, lights, materials, damage states and appropriate enter/exit animation.
Tune acceleration, braking, turning radius, grip, centre of mass, suspension or buoyancy and crash response; handling distinguishes this model from its class neighbours.
Verify traffic/parking or explicit acquisition spawn, control with keyboard/gamepad/touch, passengers, collision, destruction, saving and model-specific camera clearance.
weapon: Provide distinct original visual/audio identity, stance, aim, fire, hit, reload, recoil, muzzle/effect and damage feedback.
Enforce inventory class replacement, ammunition, reload interruption, range, accuracy, cover/vehicle restrictions and NPC reactions.
Exercise purchase/pickup/equip, damage against actors and scenery, dry firing, reload, death loss policy and save persistence.
clothing: Original garment mesh/material fits the protagonist in standing, running, cover, swimming and vehicle poses without clipping.
In-world preview, affordability, purchase, equip and saved wardrobe ownership work; slot/layer compatibility is explicit.
Outfit tags affect relevant dialogue or authored disguise checks; visual selection alone cannot complete a disguise objective.
prop: Original prop has recognisable silhouette and correct placement/holding animation.
If throwable: pickup, aim, throw, collision/breakage, re-pickup where appropriate and witness reaction work.
If scenery/advertised: readable original artwork and environmental context exist; it must not be presented as an implemented consumable.
multiplayer: Use at least two real clients against an authoritative session; shared actor/vehicle state, objective events and scores converge.
Reconnect/disconnect, late joining or intentional rejection, host/session failure, invalid actions, cheating attempts and end-of-round recovery are handled.
Bots or local simulation supplement verification but do not prove network multiplayer. Load-test advertised player capacity.

acceptance: Walk, sprint, crouch, jump, climb/vault, ladders, ledges, stairs, swim and recover from falls with collision-aware animation.
Camera avoids walls; facing, aim and animation remain consistent through locomotion, combat and vehicle transitions.
World interiors, street crossings, waterfront and elevated routes support authored missions and spontaneous play.
Enter/leave and traverse contextual cover, blind fire, aim and switch shoulders; enemy flanking and suppression change player decisions.
Unarmed strike, block/dodge, counter, grapple/disarm and weapon melee use visible timing and hit reactions.
Ballistic penetration policy, explosive/fire damage, civilian danger and ally safety affect the live encounter.
Vehicles obey road topology, signals and junctions; drivers react to collisions, sirens, threats and blockage.
Pedestrians have schedules, conversations, object interactions, fear, aggression, injury and emergency reactions.
Streaming/de-spawning must preserve mission actors and saved vehicles; dense street tests meet measured performance budgets.
Carjack occupied/locked vehicles with appropriate actor reactions and animations; passenger entry and seat occupancy are enforced.
Cars, motorcycles, boats and helicopters have distinct steering and physical behaviours; wheels, tyres, doors, glass, engines and rotors can fail.
Motorcycle lean, wheelie/stoppie and ejection; boat wakes/water exits; helicopter pitch/roll/lift and low bridges are playable.
Observed offences create evidence and escalating response; low-level stops/arrest differ from tactical pursuit.
Police use navigation, sight/hearing, dispatch, roadblocks, pursuit vehicles, helicopters and tactical squads appropriate to severity.
Last-known-position search expands with severity; breaking sight alone is insufficient while inside the search region.
Reacquisition restarts the search; hiding/changing an unobserved vehicle influences identification; losing pursuit works without a timer-only shortcut.
Death and arrest present distinct outcomes, costs, inventory policies and respawn locations.
Mission retry restores checkpoint state consistently; free-roam recovery preserves completed objectives and does not duplicate cash/items.
Cash comes from authored jobs, appropriate pickups and vehicle sales; expenses include equipment, clothes, meals, repair, travel and recovery.
Prices, rewards and loss conditions are stored per content record and balanced so early survival and late wealth change choices.
Repeated deliveries never double-pay; integer currency and transactions survive save/load.
Each unlock/loss/optional ownership branch changes an actual enterable interior and its narrative possessions.
Sleeping, saving, wardrobe, television, selected computer access and reserved vehicle spaces have working interactions.
Store/reload vehicles with model, position and meaningful state; crowded parking and missing/deleted vehicles are handled.
Drive into a physical service bay, quote/pay and repair appropriate vehicle components.
Pursuit-clearing eligibility checks witnesses and mission restrictions; respraying alone cannot silently erase observed offences.
Vehicle paint/material selection and mechanical repairs persist; destroyed vehicles cannot be resurrected through a marker.
Walk up, select/pay and animate consumption at restaurants, stands and vending machines.
Health restoration obeys bounds, price and interruptions; eating socially counts only with the invited companion present.
Separate usable food, handheld waste and advertised products; food existence must be visible in the world.
Ordered drinks generate temporary locomotion/camera/control changes and companion reactions.
Taxis/transit remain accessible during intoxication; unsafe driving produces a meaningful public response.
Accessibility options reduce screen distortion while preserving disclosed mechanical consequences.
Track affinity, respect, story availability, daily schedule, preferences, invitation/cancellation, pickup, multi-stop outing and return.
Travel dialogue is context-sensitive and companions enter vehicles, play activities, react to danger and recover from hospitalisation.
Earned favour thresholds and cooldowns deliver physical transport, a supplier, allied backup, aerial travel and a remote device service.
Optional scheduling and quiet hours improve invitation friction without replacing relationship play with a score button.

systems.source_item: Dates and three internet relationship benefits
acceptance: Two story-linked and three discoverable online contacts each have original preferences, availability, dates and relationship consequences.
Outfit/vehicle/venue tags, punctuality and behaviour affect the date; invitations respect consent and story closure.
Three earned services support treatment/advice, legal assistance and apparel discounts; limitations/cooldowns are visible and tested.
Accept dispatch by phone, acquire a suitable licensed vehicle, find the passenger and deliver a real actor along a navigable route.
Punctuality, passenger survival, vehicle condition and conduct affect success/pay; the source missable window is represented by an original narrative transition.
Provide post-story archival replay so the original missability need not block LOWLIGHT completion.
Phone dispatch provides a physical package and vehicle; timed run, rival interception and undercover interception are separate encounter implementations.
Package possession/delivery, ambusher defeat or escape and vehicle/actor state drive success; content records use distinct routes and encounter geometry.
Read/respond to an actual in-world email, locate/identify the requested model, steal it under scenario-specific opposition and deliver it intact.
Owner confrontation, fleeing target, open parked acquisition and pursuit escape all exist as authored cases; payment reflects damage/repair cost.

systems.source_item: Photographic vehicle requests and ongoing sales
acceptance: Phone image and neighbourhood clues locate a specific placed vehicle; no initial objective marker gives away the solution.
Only the correct requested entity advances the commission; condition-sensitive payment and request cooldown work.
After all commissions, an ongoing original vehicle market accepts broader models with clear prices and abuse-resistant transactions.
Payphone briefing, physical supply cache, target behaviour, protection/transport and approach options are implemented per contract.
Each target encounter has distinct tactical geometry and movement; a generic eliminate-X wave cannot certify all nine.
Stationary law-enforcement vehicle provides region-specific dossiers, photos, select/map actions and tracked completion.
Target groups occupy distinct spaces or flee by foot/car/motorcycle; multi-level fights and split escapes are authored.
LOWLIGHT offers capture/surrender where its narrative permits; legitimate completion requires every target accounted for rather than simply no enemies nearby.
Foot pursuit, stolen-vehicle pursuit and group disturbance are three real incident families.
Dispatch reachability uses road/network travel time, vehicle commitment and arrival conditions; escalation varies threats and tactics.
At least twenty successful incidents satisfy the corresponding milestone, while incident generation remains playable afterwards.
Physical start grid, opponent AI, ordered checkpoints, laps, false start/reset, finishing order and payout work.
Courses traverse distinct authored city layouts; traffic risk and vehicle classes change tactics.
All nine are individually tracked; repeated wins remain available and the twenty-win milestone is separate.
Fourteen distinct original adult characters support their staged encounter chains, schedules, prerequisites and story-dependent survival/availability.
Conversation-only encounters are intentional authored scenes; escort, intervention, surveillance, recovery, emergency transport and ambush episodes require their actual mechanics.
All twenty-two episodes are retained in project scope, including optional source encounters omitted by the source 100% formula.
Aim, approach, power/release and spin affect ball/pin physics or a validated deterministic pin simulation.
Complete ten frames with strikes/spares/bonus rolls and correct scoring; meaningful opponent shots and accessibility assistance exist.
Full game win, single frame, three consecutive strikes, companion outing and interrupted session cases are verified.
Aim/timing controls darts that score by actual board region; turns, busts and legal double-out follow a disclosed rule set.
Opponent decisions, remaining-score display, match win and three-dart maximum-score milestone work.
Aim, cue power, ball collision and pockets determine outcomes; solids/stripes assignment, scratches, turns and legal eight-ball victory work.
NPC can make strategic shots; fouls and premature eight-ball loss are tested, including companion/solo play.
Original falling-piece puzzle has spatial placement/rotation, combination clearing, increasing challenge and loss conditions.
Scoring/high score depends on player puzzle play; controls, persistence, pause and cabinet exit work.
Comedy and cabaret contain original produced performances with staging, sound, animation and a usable viewing camera.
Adult venues have distinct original environments and non-explicit adult performance content, service prices, interruption/reaction and companion visits.
Watching a progress bar or synthetic text listing does not fulfil a performed-content requirement.
Companion invites, spawn/pickup, optional accompanying adults, boarding, navigation and return are physical interactions.
Distinct boat and helicopter outings include original contextual dialogue and sightseeing beats.
Hail an actual available cab, board the passenger seat and choose a landmark or waypoint.
Driver follows the road network; normal/hurry/skip options and distance fare work, with a valid final disembark point.
A friend benefit summons a real service vehicle and driver; zero fare still follows the same trip mechanics.
Stations connect street entrances, concourses, platforms, tracks and timed moving trains; players board/alight and pay.
Each route has explicit service sequence/direction; underground/elevated travel and interchanges are navigable.
Unlocks and police restrictions change service; train/actor collision and safe camera transitions work.
Two physical termini, moving cabins, dwell times, doors and board/alight interaction form a complete crossing.
Rider camera and arrival collision are safe; transit remains distinct from helicopter travel.
Purchase/board each tour from a physical departure point; fly a distinct cinematic route with original city commentary.
Landing, skipping, interruption and unique-tour tracking work; five copies of the same orbit do not qualify.
Place each original target at a distinct authored location with readable discovery cue and a required interact/hit event.
Placement is reachable under the intended traversal mechanics and is tracked individually with saved state.
Provide late-game map clues/remaining count; completing a counter without finding all placements does not qualify.
Every jump has authored launch volume, velocity/direction constraints, flight path, landing area and success/failure adjudication.
At least two watercraft stunt lines preserve source vehicle diversity; cinematic framing does not obstruct control.
Unique successful landing is persisted; repeated jumps cannot inflate completion.
Fourteen individually modelled crossing gaps include valid entry/exit volumes and collision-aware rotor clearance.
Only actual flight under the correct span advances the challenge; map clues and save state are verified.
Original challenge variations cover all source achievement subjects plus platform-equivalent completion reward.
Single-player completion, optional content, multiplayer accomplishments and all-content project coverage are distinct transparent counters.
Do not declare full-game completion from the source 100% subset; all source feature records and outstanding research gaps must be resolved.

systems.source_item: Phone calls, text, image messages and organiser
acceptance: Contacts/branches, outgoing/incoming calls, interruption, text/images, organiser appointments and missed-call recovery work.
Phone camera acquires mission-relevant visible subjects; message attachments and replies affect authored objectives.
Themes, ringtones, accessibility text settings, emergency dispatch, cheats and multiplayer entry have functional paths.
Phone upgrade changes available features and presentation; modern archive/photo saving is permitted as an original improvement.

systems.source_item: Internet, email, dating, news and satirical sites
acceptance: Physical computers open a local fictional browser with address/search, navigation/history, mail and saved notifications.
Jobs, dating, recruitment/rendezvous and vehicle-seller contact have relevant state transitions; original news changes with the campaign.
Every indexed source website has a distinct original counterpart and produced content; gameplay-critical pages cannot be static facsimiles.
A criminal-service sting can supply the source trap mechanic through original illicit contraband fiction; no source artwork/text or real browsing is required.
Each music/talk role receives an original channel with produced music, DJ segments, ads and appropriate content transitions.
Vehicle/city playback, tuning, volume, station availability and mission dialogue ducking are real audible features.
Identify a playing original track through the phone and store title/artist; user audio import never grants game access to unrelated files.
Safehouse TV plays produced original programmes and ads with channel switching, volume and valid performance/video animation.
Programmes differ in content, rhythm and visual presentation; blank screens or generated title lists do not meet acceptance.

systems.source_item: Original online modes and ranked progression
acceptance: Implement all fifteen enumerated source mode roles and their authored variations, not a single sandbox labelled fifteen ways.
Quick/custom/private/ranked entry, rules, lobby, character appearance, rank progression and score persistence work.
32-player PC-equivalent capacity is a measured release target, with mode-specific limits; real multi-client play and reconnection are mandatory.
Record recent live simulation state or footage; browse clips and edit ordering, timing, camera where supported, titles, transitions and audio.
Export an inspectable video artifact; error/storage handling and disabled capture performance are verified.
No retired Rockstar upload service is assumed.
User explicitly selects local supported audio; sequential and shuffle playback plus authored broadcast interstitials work.
Import failure, empty playlist, volume ducking and persistence are verified without uploading private files.
Map pan/zoom, world/route markers, district boundaries, waypoint routing and discovery state correspond to actual geometry.
Progress/stats, tutorials, accessible control rebinding, subtitles, graphics/audio controls and save management have working effects.
Menus support keyboard/gamepad/touch and viewport-safe legibility without covering critical play.

systems.source_item: World time, weather and ambient audio
acceptance: Continuous day/night, weather/lighting, wet roads, ambient sound and scheduled activities change the simulated city.
Clock advancement through sleeping/travel/retry preserves prerequisite appointments and encounter cooldowns.
Original physical storefronts and an earned mobile supplier sell visible stock with progression locks and condition-safe transactions.
Cash/ammo/armour changes are atomic; unavailable requested equipment cannot appear silently in inventory.
Enumerated prop families have distinct original assets; selected light props can be picked up and thrown with visible actor animation and reactions.
Prop density and persistence are bounded without deleting active objective items; environmental cylinders/fire hydrants react physically.
Explicit cheat entry changes disclosed health/armour, equipment, pursuit, weather or vehicle spawning.
Save/progress/achievement policy is communicated; cheats cannot conceal unfinished content during verification.
